common_contract.scope: Adapt a complete grouping core, not the source image backbone, decoder, or source task loss. Acceptance means the architecture and mapping are specified; it is not measured performance or training authorization.
common_contract.input: For one valid utterance: L in R^256, forward Base B in R^(8x64), and fixed typed Gap G in R^(3x8x64), types A/T/V. Use only already-computed reads. Ordinary supported cases contain 1 Local + 8 Base + 0/8/16 active Gap tokens.
common_contract.fixed_storage: 33 typed positions: Local, B1..B8, GA1..GA8, GT1..GT8, GV1..GV8. Inactive positions are excluded; storage padding is not an extra observation. No splitting Local into invented tokens.
adapter: Let valid and history be existing causal validity/history indicators; let gap_active[m] be the existing missing-modality read mask. These are deterministic guards, not sampled masks.
Compute safe_L=where(valid,L,0); l=where(valid,GELU(Linear256to64(LayerNorm256(safe_L))),0). Local token x_0=l+e_Local, then re-mask.

For each real read r_(type,h), safe_r=where(active_(type,h),r,0); x_(type,h)=where(active_(type,h),GELU(P_type(LayerNorm64(safe_r))+C_type(l)+e_type+e_head[h]),0). P_type and C_type are 64-to-64 affine maps; four types are Base/GA/GT/GV; eight head embeddings share their indexing across types.

Base active=valid AND history; Gap active=valid AND history AND gap_active[m]. Local active=valid. Local conditioning enters all memory-token votes through C_type(l), and Local itself participates once.

Use torch.where before reading any inactive value and after every biased token operation. NaN in an inactive read cannot affect values or gradients. All subsequent computations are per utterance; no batch statistics or temporal convolution.
Token identity follows its source/head metadata under permutations. No adjacency, linguistic order, object identity, pose, or missing-latent semantics are assigned to the tokens.
boundary: The outer readout branch is evaluated only when valid AND history. Otherwise its 128-dimensional correction feature is exactly zero, including the first valid utterance.
With no active Gap but history present, execute the unchanged grouping core on Local plus eight Base tokens. There is no synthetic Gap token.
For an all-inactive direct unit-test input, return exact zeros before normalization, routing, or Sinkhorn. Invalid/padded outputs are zeroed again after the output projection.

Active all-zero numeric inputs must remain finite; they need not produce zero learned features because identity embeddings are allowed. This differs from all-inactive and no-history, which must be exact zero.
common_contract.integration: Each core returns z in R^128. The common integration may use f_new=f_Flat+where(valid AND history,W_out z+b_out,0), where the output affine layer has bias enabled, both W_out and b_out are zero-initialized, and it maps 128 to the existing Flat feature dimension (do not hard-code an incompatible width). The outer guard zeros the complete affine correction, including a learned bias, on invalid/no-history rows. Preserve the original classifier/loss, all existing masks and checkpoint-selection protocol; train active backbone and readout jointly. No auxiliary objective, reconstruction, completion, class-specific routing target, gold label input, extra OSRAM query/write/scan/cache, or extra paired view.
common_contract.numerics: Routing and transport statistics use float32 even under mixed precision. All unrolled steps retain gradients. Trainable matrices use the experiment seed and Xavier initialization unless a card states otherwise. No dropout is introduced.
verification_required_before_training: Check exact shapes and mask/NaN isolation.
Check no-history/all-inactive exact-zero correction and no-Gap Base-only behavior after parameters update.
Check batch independence and absence of memory hooks/calls.
Check repeated evaluation, strict checkpoint reload, finite backward and parameter updates.

For Slot Attention, check branch training draws leave global CPU/CUDA RNG states unchanged, private RNG state advances only on executed training rows, and strict reload/full resume reproduces the next private-noise sequence; evaluation leaves both private and global RNG states unchanged.
Numerically compare each core with the pinned source equations on finite unmasked toy inputs, accounting for documented adaptation differences.

accepted.title: Dynamic Routing Between Capsules
accepted.source_provenance: First-author repository README identifies this as the code used for Dynamic Routing Between Capsules; README and actual routing file inspected.

code_evidence.finding: Parent-specific votes, zero logit initialization, parent competition, squash and cumulative dot-product agreement.

exact_mapping: Use all active common-contract tokens. For each of 33 typed positions i and each parent j in 1..4, compute a 32-vector vote uhat_ij=W_ij x_i with W_ij in R^(32x64), bias-free. Exclude inactive i from every sum and agreement update.
Reset b_ij=0 on every utterance. In each of three rounds: c_ij=softmax over the four parents; s_j=sum_active_i c_ij uhat_ij; v_j=q/(1+q) * s_j/sqrt(max(q,1e-8)), q=sum_d s_jd^2.
After rounds 1 and 2, b_ij += dot(uhat_ij,v_j); the equivalent unused last-round logit update may be omitted. Do not detach votes or intermediate routing logits.
Concatenate the four final 32-vectors in learned-parent order to produce z in R^128. All-inactive/no-history guards follow the common contract.
accepted.local_conditioning: Local appears as one lower capsule and conditions all Base/Gap tokens in the shared input adapter; parent logits are still initialized to zero, preserving routing-by-agreement.
accepted.input_output_mask: Inactive votes and their logit updates are zero/excluded. Parent states are temporary within the utterance; output is hard-zero outside valid-history rows.
original_to_adapted_changes: Replace visual lower capsules with typed read-head vectors.
Use the paper's bias-free sum rather than the optional bias in released code; use zero-safe squash.
Output capsule vectors, not class probabilities; omit image convolutions, margin loss and reconstruction decoder.
accepted.hypothesis: Parent-specific transforms may combine mutually consistent Local/Base/Gap votes while allowing incompatible evidence to support different latent groups.
accepted.distinct_reason: Agreement is accumulated into per-input routing logits and followed by vector squash; there is no GRU state, covariance posterior, or balanced transport constraint.
limitations: Agreement can amplify correlated or redundant read heads.
Four groups and three rounds are fixed preregistered choices, not evidence of optimality.
Capsules are latent evidence groups; no object/pose or missing-modality reconstruction claim.

accepted.title: Object-Centric Learning with Slot Attention
accepted.source_provenance: Paper-linked Google reference implementation; README and actual SlotAttention class inspected.

code_evidence.finding: Shared Gaussian parameters, bias-free Q/K/V, competition over slots, input-axis weighted mean, GRU and residual MLP.

retained_core: Distinct initial slot draws from shared Gaussian parameters
exact_mapping: Use common-contract tokens, then per-token LayerNorm64 and bias-free K,V projections 64-to-64. Re-mask after normalization.
Initialize four slots s_j=mu+exp(log_sigma)*epsilon_j using shared learned 64-vector mu and log_sigma. Set log_sigma=0 at initialization, mu Xavier; slots do not have separate learned means.

Training: use a dedicated branch-owned torch.Generator(device='cpu'), initialized with seed (experiment_seed+104729) modulo 2^63. Its state is held in a persistent uint8 checkpoint buffer named training_noise_rng_state. Before each executed training call, restore this private CPU generator from training_noise_rng_state.detach().cpu(); draw independent standard-normal float32 epsilon[N_active_history,4,64] on CPU using only that generator, in the existing batch-row order; then save its updated state back to the persistent buffer and transfer epsilon to the slot device/dtype. No call to global manual_seed, randn without this generator, or CUDA random generation is allowed. Thus the branch noise consumes neither baseline global CPU/CUDA RNG nor dropout/mask streams. If no row has valid history, skip the draw and leave private state unchanged.

Strict checkpoint loading and full training resume restore training_noise_rng_state before the next branch draw; do not reseed it from experiment_seed after loading. The state buffer follows module checkpoint/device handling, while generator.set_state receives a CPU copy. A complete resume additionally restores the original optimizer/progress/global RNG states under the unchanged experiment protocol. Evaluation uses one fixed epsilon_eval[4,64] sampled once with a separate isolated CPU generator seed 1729, saved as a persistent checkpoint buffer and broadcast to all rows; evaluation neither draws noise nor changes the private training RNG state. Reset slot state for every utterance.
For exactly three rounds, compute logits_ij=dot(K_i,Q(LN(s_j)))/sqrt(64); A_ij=softmax_j(logits_ij). Form W_ij=mask_i*(A_ij+1e-8)/sum_active_k(A_kj+1e-8); update_j=sum_i W_ij V_i.
Set s_j=GRU64(update_j,old_s_j); then s_j += Linear128to64(ReLU(Linear64to128(LN(s_j)))). Share all refinement weights over slots and rounds.
Apply shared phi=Linear64to64+GELU to final slots; concatenate mean_j(phi(s_j)) and max_j(phi(s_j)) into z in R^128. This symmetric readout does not attach class meaning to slot indices.
accepted.local_conditioning: Local is a real input token and conditions each memory token through the shared adapter. No extra query is made against OSRAM; Q refers only to temporary slot-to-token attention.
accepted.input_output_mask: Inactive input rows are excluded before the epsilon renormalization, not merely zeroed as values. All-inactive rows bypass the core. Final z follows valid-history hard-zero guard.
original_to_adapted_changes: Read-head token features replace image features.

Fixed common-random-number evaluation replaces the reference implementation's random evaluation draws; training retains Gaussian resampling but uses an isolated, experiment-seeded, checkpointed CPU generator to preserve the baseline dropout/mask RNG streams. This RNG isolation is an engineering adaptation, not a claim about the original implementation.
Symmetric mean/max readout replaces object decoder or set-prediction head; only original task loss is used.
accepted.hypothesis: Competition followed by a learned recurrent update may allocate different temporary slots to complementary evidence groups, rather than only reinforcing instantaneous agreement.
accepted.distinct_reason: The essential chain is competition -> normalized evidence summary -> GRU state update -> residual refinement, not just a different softmax axis.
limitations: Task-only supervision may produce redundant or source-specialized slots; no object-discovery claim.
Fixed evaluation noise is a disclosed adaptation and must be held constant across checkpoints/seeds, not chosen using test results.

Stochastic training needs the persistent private RNG-state buffer as well as the original training state for exact resume; changing active-row batching changes private draw assignment and is not claimed trajectory-equivalent.

accepted.title: A Trainable Optimal Transport Embedding for Feature Aggregation and its Relationship to Attention
accepted.license: No repository license located in inspected root/README; do not copy source. This card specifies an independent mathematical adaptation.
accepted.source_provenance: Paper explicitly links claying/OTK; README, OTKernel and both Sinkhorn implementations inspected.
accepted.paper_evidence: Section 3.2 Definition 3.1: nonlinear feature embedding, transport alignment to learned reference, and multi-bin embedding; paper also evaluates a neural-network module variant.

code_evidence.finding: Learned supports, Sinkhorn attention and support-wise feature aggregation.
Log-domain alternating marginal scaling and dot-product support similarities.

code_evidence.lines: Using OTKernel as a module in NNs
code_evidence.finding: Released example explicitly precedes OTKernel with Linear and ReLU.

retained_core: Entropically regularized transport with both marginals constrained
exact_mapping: On active tokens compute h_i=normalize(ReLU(Linear64to64(x_i)),eps=1e-8); re-mask. Learn four support vectors z_j in R^64, Xavier initialized, and normalize each with the same epsilon. These are persistent parameters, not cached sample state.

Construct C_ij=-dot(h_i,z_j). Use uniform source mass a_i=1/n for n active tokens and target mass b_j=1/4. Solve the entropy-regularized OT approximation with exactly 30 differentiable log-domain Sinkhorn rounds.

For packed active rows, logK=-C/0.5; initialize log_u=0, log_v=0. Each round: log_u_i=log(1/n)-logsumexp_j(logK_ij+log_v_j); log_v_j=log(1/4)-logsumexp_i(logK_ij+log_u_i). Then T=exp(logK+log_u+log_v). Unpack inactive rows as exact zero.

Use the paper's unit-mass normalization: Phi_j=sqrt(4)*sum_i T_ij h_i. Flatten four 64-vectors and apply Linear256to128 to obtain z. Do not collapse supports to an ordinary mean before the learned output projection.
The OT entropy term defines the internal transport plan; it is NOT added to the training loss. All references, nonlinear map and output projection train only through the original task loss.
accepted.local_conditioning: Both the Local token and Local-conditioned memory tokens enter the transport problem. References remain global learned parameters as in the source; no label-conditioned or per-dialogue reference cache.
accepted.input_output_mask: Operate on packed active tokens so zero-mass inactive rows never enter logarithms. The empty set returns zero before Sinkhorn. No-Gap uses exactly nine tokens; no-history correction remains zero.
original_to_adapted_changes: Use the source-supported neural nonlinear feature map rather than a Gaussian Nyström approximation; do not claim the original Gaussian kernel guarantee.
No positional encoding or sequence convolution because heads have no spatial order.
Use paper sqrt(p)*T aggregation; official OTKernel returns p*T-style per-support means, a known fixed scale difference.
Random supervised parameter initialization replaces unsupervised K-means pretraining; no new objective or dataset pass.
accepted.hypothesis: Global mass constraints can discourage all read evidence from collapsing into a single support and retain several complementary summaries despite varying numbers of missing modalities.
accepted.distinct_reason: Assignments are coupled through both source and target mass constraints and a learned reference geometry. Thirty Sinkhorn updates solve this constrained allocation; they are not independent attention or recurrent slot updates.
limitations: Uniform target capacity may force weak evidence into a support; this is the intended bias being tested.
Finite Sinkhorn iterations approximate the source marginals; marginal residuals must be logged in unit checks, not turned into an extra loss.
No claim of a discovered object, calibrated uncertainty, or recovered missing latent.

accepted.title: Capsule Routing via Variational Bayes
accepted.source_provenance: Paper footnote links the first author's official implementation; README, matrix-vote layer and complete VB-routing source inspected.
accepted.paper_evidence: Section 2.2 and Algorithm 1: transformed matrix votes, conjugate posterior updates, responsibility refinement and post-routing activation. Capsule-VAE extension in Section 2.3 is not used.

code_evidence.finding: Per-child/per-parent trainable matrix transformations produce vectorized matrix votes.
Uniform initialization, sufficient-statistic/conjugate updates, expected-log responsibility calculation and entropy-based final activation.

retained_core: 4x4 input matrices and parent-specific matrix multiplication votes
Expected log mixing/precision and Mahalanobis responsibilities
Posterior mean and entropy-derived activation outputs
exact_mapping: For each common token x_i, create M_i=reshape(Linear64to16(x_i),4,4) and a_i=clamp(sigmoid(Linear64to1(x_i)),1e-6,1-1e-6). Use per-type projection maps. Inactive inputs have M_i=a_i=0 after where, regardless of biases.

For each typed input position i and parent j in 1..4, learn W_ij in R^(4x4); set v_ij=vec(M_i W_ij). Use one fully connected grouping region; no spatial unfolding, coordinate addition or sequential neighborhoods.
Initialize r_ij=1/4 for active i. Each of three rounds computes w_ij=a_i r_ij, N_j=sum_i w_ij, mean_j=sum_i w_ij v_ij/max(N_j,1e-8), and scatter_j=sum_i w_ij(v_ij-mean_j)(v_ij-mean_j)^T.

Posterior parameters: alpha_j=1+N_j, kappa_j=1+N_j, nu_j=17+N_j, m_j=N_j mean_j/kappa_j, invPsi_j=I+scatter_j+(N_j/kappa_j)mean_j mean_j^T. Use Cholesky with 1e-6 I numerical jitter and solves, not an unstable explicit inverse.

Compute Elogpi_j=digamma(alpha_j)-digamma(sum_k alpha_k), Elogdet_j=16 log(2)-logdet(invPsi_j)+sum_(d=0..15)digamma((nu_j-d)/2). For rounds 1 and 2, score_ij=Elogpi_j+0.5 Elogdet_j-0.5*(16/kappa_j+nu_j*(v_ij-m_j)^T solve(invPsi_j,v_ij-m_j)); r_ij=softmax_j(score_ij). Round 3 finalizes posterior statistics.

Choose the released-code entropy-activation variant explicitly: H_j=8*log(2*pi*e)-0.5*Elogdet_j; A_j=sigmoid(beta_a_j-exp(Elogpi_j)*H_j-beta_u_j), with learned beta_a=beta_u=0 initially. Omit source BatchNorm on means/activation so rows cannot affect one another.

Concatenate the four A_j*m_j vectors (64 scalars) and four A_j scalars, then Linear68to128 gives z. For N_j<=1e-8 force A_j and its weighted mean output to zero; whole-row no-history/all-inactive guards apply.
Unroll the closed-form posterior calculations with gradients; do not add an ELBO, KL, reconstruction, spread/margin loss, posterior sampling, VAE path, or labels to the readout inputs.
accepted.local_conditioning: Local-conditioned common tokens produce all lower matrices and activations. The Local vector participates once; no geometric interpretation is attached to its matrix reshape.
accepted.input_output_mask: Inactive rows contribute zero mass, no scatter and no assignments. Temporary posterior statistics reset every utterance. No batch normalization, persistent posterior cache or sample mixing.
original_to_adapted_changes: Use one nonspatial fully connected group and typed readout-derived matrices.
Preserve full-covariance conjugate updates from Algorithm 1; omit image backbone, coordinates and source classification head.
Select the official code's entropy activation rather than claiming it equals paper equation 14; the code omits the paper's outer mass factor and uses exp(Elogpi)*entropy.
Omit post-routing batch normalization for utterance isolation; numerical floors and output projection are declared adaptations.
accepted.hypothesis: Posterior shrinkage and covariance-aware agreement may prevent small, contradictory head groups from acquiring overconfident assignments when few Gap heads are active.
accepted.distinct_reason: Unlike dynamic routing, agreement uses learned-matrix votes and uncertainty-aware Gaussian statistics with fixed conjugate priors; unlike Slot Attention there is no GRU; unlike OTKE there are no forced equal target masses.
limitations: This is a deterministic differentiable Bayesian-routing computation, not a claim of calibrated Bayesian uncertainty for emotion prediction.
16-dimensional matrices are learned arrangements of features, not poses.
Cholesky/statistical updates cost more than the other three grouping cores; small current-read sets keep the design bounded.
The selected entropy activation and normalization choices differ from the published equation, so label it adapted VB routing, not exact reproduction.

rejected.title: Matrix capsules with EM routing
rejected.paper_evidence: Primary PDF Sections 2-3 and Procedure 1 inspected: matrix transforms, activation-weighted Gaussian M/E updates and cost-based activation.
rejected.reason: No original-author official implementation verified. The IBM implementation is official for Ashley Gritzman's reproduction/pitfalls paper, not for the original Hinton/Sabour/Frosst paper; do not relabel it.
rejected.supporting_evidence: Gritzman's primary paper, Abstract and Introduction, explicitly documents the absence of the original source release and identifies IBM/matrix-capsules-with-em-routing as his implementation.
rejected.architectural_note: EM routing itself could structurally fit the same read-head interface; rejection here is provenance under this lane's mandatory official-code requirement, not a claim that the mathematics cannot transfer.
